# OKZest

OKZest is a design automation platform for inspecting reusable designs and rendering personalized images through its REST API.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/okzest/.

## Actions

- **Get Design** (read-only): Return one OKZest design, including its editable URL parameters and usage counters, by design ID.
- **Get Design Fields** (read-only): List the editable field descriptors, accepted types, and choices for an OKZest design before rendering it.
- **List Designs** (read-only): Return one page of designs available to the connected OKZest account.
- **Render Image**: Render an image from an OKZest design with optional temporary layer or background changes.
